Index.meta_title: Yamato ERP - Smart Garment Manufacturing Management System
Index.meta_description: Comprehensive SaaS solution for garment production management, from planning to delivery. Optimize processes, reduce costs, increase production efficiency.

Hero.title: Smart <important>garment manufacturing</important> management system
Hero.description: Comprehensive SaaS solution helping garment factories and contractors manage from orders, production planning to quality control. Optimize processes, reduce waste, increase profits.

Features.section_title: Comprehensive solution for garment and contracting industry
Features.section_description: Integrated management system covering production planning, raw material management to quality control and delivery.
Features.feature1_description: Track orders from receipt to completion. Manage customer information, technical specs, timeline and progress.
Features.feature2_description: Smart production planning, allocate processes, machinery and workforce. Optimize capacity and reduce waiting time.
Features.feature3_description: Manage fabric and accessory inventory, control stock levels. Automatically calculate material requirements by order and shortage alerts.
Features.feature4_description: QC/QA system at each stage. Track defects, quality reports and ensure export standards.
Features.feature5_description: Accurate production cost calculation by order. Analyze profitability and optimize pricing strategy.
Features.feature6_description: Real-time KPI tracking dashboard. Production performance reports, quality analysis and business trend insights.
Features.feature_description: Comprehensive SaaS solution for garment and contracting industry.
